visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair, wearing a grey zip-up jacket over a black shirt, stands in a lush green forest. He looks directly at the camera while speaking. Behind him, tall deciduous trees with vibrant green leaves fill the background. The lighting is natural and diffuse, suggesting an overcast day. A roped-off area with white stakes and signs is visible in the background. (2) The camera pans to the right to reveal a designated area within the camping grounds. The ground is dark soil. There are four large, weathered metal barrels lined up against a low wall of dark volcanic rocks. Two small signs with Japanese text are mounted on white poles, and the entire area is enclosed by thin ropes with pink and yellow markers. Green shrubs and tall trees surround this specific zone. (3) The lens zooms slightly closer to the metal barrels and a yellow rectangular mat placed on the ground in front of them. The ground around the barrels is cleared of vegetation, showing dark ash-like soil. The background continues to show dense foliage and large tree trunks. The camera movement is steady handheld, following the man's explanation of the site's layout. (4) The shot shifts back to the man's face as he concludes his presentation. He maintains a calm and informative expression. The background remains the same forest setting. A yellow text overlay at the bottom of the screen provides a headline throughout the video, while white subtitles change as he speaks. The overall atmosphere is educational and serene.
